subject: Decision Making
title: Lying to Protect Someone
description: A quick, practical guide to Lying to Protect Someone.

hook.text: Your friend asks if their terrible business idea is good. Honesty might crush them. A lie might waste their savings.

buildup.text: Kant said never lie. Utilitarianism says lie if it produces more happiness.

discovery.text: Research shows people overestimate how much truth hurts others. Honesty creates short-term pain but long-term trust.

twist.text: Radical honesty movements tried total truth. They destroyed relationships.

climax.text: The ethics of lying depends on intent, stakes, and alternatives. A universal rule does not fit every situation.

punchline.text: Spare their feelings or tell the truth? No universal rule. Context decides.

quiz.question: Why is lying to protect someone ethically complex?
options: Intent, stakes, and consequences vary so no single rule fits all situations
